name: picks-first-candidate
note: the router model replies with candidate 'TinyLLM', so rule route-TinyLLM fires and routes there

name: picks-second-candidate
note: the router model replies with candidate 'BigLLM', so rule route-BigLLM fires and routes there

name: picks-default-candidate
note: the router model explicitly picks 'DefaultLLM', so rule route-DefaultLLM fires and default_used is false; this is distinct from falling open to DefaultLLM, where default_used is true

name: unknown-model-falls-open
note: the reply is valid but names 'huge', which is not a candidate, so no rule matches and routing falls back to default_model, DefaultLLM

name: chat-failure-falls-open
note: the router model call fails and no on_error is set, so the failure counts as no-match and routing falls back to default_model, DefaultLLM
